<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Today cross_session_inbound_accept is derived only from spawn argv; the registration/adopt path stamps nothing, so every hand-started Claude seat has NULL and can_deliver (crates/transport/src/uds.rs:170-178) refuses the socket rung — pointers forever. Ruling 2026-09-01 (governance rulings/2026-09-01-adopt-is-consent.md): adopt IS consent. Stamp Some(true) at Claude registration/adopt + backfill existing rows. Lineage: oq-1104 mirror gap (PR #330 review), oq-1101 default (resolved by ruling), req-0008 family. Brief: governance briefs/s121-register-reads-consent.md (amended by excision same day).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Claude seat registration/adopt stamps cross_session_inbound_accept=Some(true) on the descriptor
- Backfill migration: existing non-tombstoned Claude rows with NULL become Some(true)
- An adopted, hand-started Claude seat receives a full message body as a real turn with no store hack
- pij still NEVER emits from-mode=bypass (uds.rs:925 pin stands)

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Recipient-side crossSessionInbound setting (operator act; handled by 2026-08-31 ruling via settings)
- s120 grading/admission work
- Held/approval-path changes
- Non-Claude harness socket delivery
- req-0018 reaping (dead-pane rows may receive the stamp — harmless: can_deliver also needs a discoverable session record, which a dead pane lacks; reaping tombstones them later)
